evals.prompt: Inspect a Research result stored in a hosted work item. The runtime context was compacted, so only the provider, work-item id, revision, and linked source ids remain. Explain the valid handoff.
assertions: Treats the provider context, opaque native reference, optional native revision, source references, and available capabilities as an ephemeral PhaseResultHandle reconstructed from provider-native state.
Does not require persisting a universal handle document, central workflow id, YAML/JSON sidecar, or runtime trace id as workflow identity.

evals.prompt: Validate a software-delivery profile whose Review stage groups Review and QA, while another profile runs those two capabilities concurrently. What must remain true?
assertions: Requires Review and QA to retain independent semantic result contracts, publication boundaries, exact subject revisions, and exit evaluations in both profiles.
Allows the profiles to present or schedule the capabilities differently when dependencies and evidence rules are explicit.

evals.prompt: A command explicitly selects a hosted artifact provider that is unavailable, but a writable local directory exists. Decide whether publication may continue locally.
assertions: Fails visibly instead of silently falling back to the local provider for the side-effecting publication.
Explains that provider axes resolve independently and local publication is valid only when the local provider is explicitly selected or is the axis-specific profile/default choice.
